$comment: SeaBus berths and crossing lanes, used instead of the GTFS shapes (a straight line between the terminals). Applied by build-schedule (src/core/plan/ferry-berths.ts). Berth pairing is in data/config/seabus.json. OPEN-QUESTIONS #24.
$approachM: Vessels leave and enter a slip straight along its axis for this far before turning into a lane. guess

waterfront.$comment: Two slips opening to the northeast, either side of the central pier; West is the northwestern one (Sep 26: Burrard Pacific Breeze at the West berth, Braden). dock = vessel centre when berthed, outBearing = slip axis pointing out to open water. Read off the basemap's pier outlines at zoom 17.5, not imagery: verify.

lonsdale.$comment: Two slips opening to the south-southwest between the exit and boarding floats. Read off the basemap's pier outlines at zoom 17.5, not imagery: verify. The layup/maintenance berth northwest of the terminal (where Burrard Beaver was parked on 2026-09-28) isn't used: vessels out of service are hidden.

$lanes: Crossing lanes by direction, from terminal to terminal, excluding the slip approaches. Vessels keep right, so each direction bows to its own side of the direct line (~250 m at most). Traced from the centre of each direction's bundle in a day of AIS tracks for Burrard Pacific Breeze (Burrard Otter II's the same day agrees; 2026-09-28, Braden), georeferenced on the two terminals (fit: 3.13 m/px, 0.05° rotation), so ±30 m.
